name: @epoch/persistence
description: Epoch Provider-Neutral Persistence SPI (W046, ACR-005) — the durable-state seam between the application gateway and PostgreSQL: the typed record-store primitives (insert/get/put/delete/list, transactions with all-or-nothing commit/rollback, idempotent versioned migrations) with TWO implementations of the SAME contract — the deterministic in-memory reference and the real PostgreSQL adapter (complete wire-protocol SQL emission: exact statement text, $n placeholders, canonical-JSON value encoding, BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK transaction driving, JSONB DDL) over an injected PostgresWirePort that structurally matches the pg 8.23.0 driver API. THIS PACKAGE NEVER IMPORTS THE DRIVER (pg binding is service-layer only — enforced by the W046 pg-boundary test); the shared conformance suite runs identically against both implementations, and the golden-SQL corpus (testdata/golden-sql) pins the exact SQL every SPI operation emits — deterministic, zero timestamps, zero ordering noise. PostgreSQL is the durable authority when the adapter is bound (ACR-005); object bytes stay in @epoch/object-storage.
